context: Daichi installs a new ceiling light; Sho-young watches with curiosity.
purpose: Father teaching son basic home repair.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、電球、変えるの?
lines.en: Dad, are you changing the light bulb?
lines.style: Gentle, curious opening. Watching closely. Soft voice with that small-child lilt of genuine interest. Eyes tracking his hands. No urgency — just want to understand.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Yeah — watch me, okay? Gotta be careful.
lines.style: Warm, steady Kansai tone. Slight drawl on the reassurance. Teaching voice — not lecturing, just letting him know this matters. Patient attention to the task.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Isn't it high up? Isn't that dangerous?
lines.style: Quiet worry threading through. Not panic — genuine concern for his dad. Hesitant, like he's checking if it's okay to ask. Small voice getting smaller.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Don't worry — I know what I'm doing.
lines.style: Reassuring, confident Kansai warmth. Light touch of humor underneath — he's done this a hundred times. Steady hands in the voice. Not dismissing the worry, just settling it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: It's so bright now! That's amazing!
lines.style: Sudden delight breaking through. Bright, awed child-voice. Small laugh of wonder. Eyes up at the light. That pure moment where he sees something work and it's the best thing.
